display.title: Heroes of Genesis
display.description: A dark fantasy card RPG built for the Regenesis Labs Build Contest. Recruit heroes, fuse duplicates into legends, raid Rift bosses with friends, trade face-to-face, and climb the Roads. Then walk out into Antrom: a shared top-down overworld of villages, dungeons and puzzles where four warlords guard the story's cards. Every monster you fell can leave its card behind. 100% mobile.
